stepTitle: The optimal parameter from training with L2 regularization is most likely:
stepBody: Sam trains three versions of $$\hat{\text{attendance\_rate}} $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 (\text{dist\_from\_bell}) + \hat{\theta}_2 (\text{section\_no})$$ -- one without regularization, one with L1, and one with L2 -- obtaining $$\theta**{(a)} $$=$$ $$\begin{bmatrix$$} $$0$$ $$\\$$ $$0.1$$ $$\\$$ $$0$$ $$\end{bmatrix}$$, $$\theta**{(b)} $$=$$ $$\begin{bmatrix$$} $$1$$ $$\\$$ $$0.5$$ $$\\$$ $$2$$ $$\end{bmatrix}$$, $$\theta**{(c)} $$=$$ $$\begin{bmatrix$$} $$0.05$$ $$\\$$ $$0.08$$ $$\\$$ $$0.03$$ $$\end{bmatrix}$$.
